title: feat(console-ai): ChatDock — right-docked AI rail behind a default-off flag (ADR-0057 P3a)
body:
The first slice of ADR-0057 **P3** (the docked right rail) — shipped as an **additive, default-OFF** shell so it changes nothing until an operator opts in. The FAB stays the canonical entry; this just stands up the dock so P3b/P3c can build on a proven shell.

## What
- **`@object-ui/layout` — `AppShell.rightRail`**: an optional prop rendered as a flex sibling of the main content, so the rail **reflows** the content beside it (VS Code / Cursor idiom) rather than overlaying it. Absent → identical single-pane layout.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell` — `ChatDock`**: a collapsible, resizable right rail that reuses the shared **`ChatPane`** engine over the **P1 `(user, app, product=ask)`** conversation — the same ambient thread the FAB / `/ai` shows, so the dock is a *view*, not a new conversation. Default **collapsed** (a fixed edge launcher → zero layout cost until invoked); **⌘/Ctrl+Shift+I** toggles it. Gated on `useAiSurfaceEnabled` **AND** the flag, so OSS / no-seat runtimes render nothing.
- **`runtime-config.chatDock`**: rollout flag, parsed **default-OFF** (opt-in only, mirroring the commercial-flag pattern).

## Verification
- **Live** (flag forced on locally): the edge launcher expands to a rail rendering the ask chat; the dashboard content **reflows narrower** beside it (confirming true flex reflow, not overlay); the collapse button restores the launcher. Screenshot in the session.
- **Unit**: width clamp (neither pane collapses), the composer-safe shortcut matcher (⌘⇧I — no collision with the page's ⌘⇧O/⌘⇧S), and the flag's default-off / opt-in parse. `@object-ui/layout` + `@object-ui/app-shell` builds (tsc) clean.

## Scope notes / follow-ups
- The dock currently wires into **ConsoleLayout** (app views); the **home** shell doesn't mount it yet — trivial follow-up.
- Mobile is `md:`-gated (rail hidden below `md`); a mobile sheet is a follow-up.
- **P3b** (fold the FAB into this launcher) and **P3c** (`/ai` = maximized dock + Studio right-side reflow) come next, per the [plan](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/2409#issuecomment-4958265739).

Refs: epic #2409, ADR-0057 §P3 + Amendment A1 (#2457).
